def test_peft_original_fig1_table2_all_thirty_oct_cells(self):
        from p1_source_examples import peft_example
        rank, oct_table, oct_rank = peft_example()
        expected = [(64,68,86),(42,39,42),(27,41,43),(42,39,50),(28,37,28),
                    (42,39,44),(13,16,22),(13,16,33),(13,16,20),(0,0,0)]
        for i, row in enumerate(expected, 1):
            self.assertEqual(oct_table[str(i)], dict(zip(("P1", "P2", "P3"), row)))
        self.assertAlmostEqual(rank["1"], 169)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(oct_rank["1"], 218/3)

def test_handwritten_completions_equality_miss_and_group_quantiles(self):
        w = hand_dag()
        from p1_fixtures import HAND_INTERVALS
        rows = [dict(service=s.id, node=n.id, resource=n.durations[0].resource,
                     start=HAND_INTERVALS[n.id][0], finish=HAND_INTERVALS[n.id][1])
                for s in w.services for n in s.nodes]
        result = summarize(w, rows)
        self.assertEqual(result["groups"]["H"], dict(count=1, dmr=0, p50=13, p95=13, p99=13, maximum=13))
        self.assertEqual(result["groups"]["L"]["dmr"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(result["groups"]["L"]["p95"], 13)
        self.assertEqual(result["resources"]["CPU0"]["busy"], 4)
        self.assertEqual(result["cross_unit_data_total"], 8)  # 1+1+2+1+1+1+1 MiB
        self.assertEqual(result["makespan"], 13)

def test_missing_duplicate_or_unknown_node_cannot_be_a_metric_sample(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ModelError):
            summarize(hand_dag(), [])
        rows = [dict(service=s.id, node=n.id, finish=13) for s in hand_dag().services for n in s.nodes]
        with self.assertRaises(ModelError):
            summarize(hand_dag(), rows+[rows[0]])

def test_type7_and_absent_group_semantics(self):
        self.assertEqual(quantile([10, 20], .95), 19.5)
        self.assertEqual(quantile([7], .99), 7)
        self.assertIsNone(quantile([], .95))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            quantile([float("nan")], .95)

def test_invalid_numbers_and_compatibility_rejected(self):
        for value in (float("nan"), float("inf"), -1, 0, True):
            with self.subTest(value=value), self.assertRaises(ModelError):
                Duration("CPU0", value, 1)
        with self.assertRaises(ModelError):
            Node("x", ())
        with self.assertRaises(ModelError):
            Node("x", (Duration("CPU0", 1, 1), Duration("CPU0", 2, 2)))
        with self.assertRaises(ModelError):
            Link("CPU", "GPU", 0, 0)
        with self.assertRaises(ModelError):
            Dependency("x", -1)

def test_resource_service_and_global_node_uniqueness(self):
        w = hand_dag()
        for changed in [dict(resources=w.resources+(w.resources[0],)), dict(services=w.services+(w.services[0],)),
                        dict(services=(w.services[0], Service("other", 0, 1, "H", (node("a"),)))),
                        dict(links=w.links[:-1])]:
            with self.subTest(changed=changed), self.assertRaises(ModelError):
                replace(w, **changed)
        with self.assertRaises(ModelError):
            Workload((Service("x", 0, 1, "H", (node("x", "BAD"),)),), network())

def test_same_unit_zero_and_cross_unit_formula(self):
        w = replace(hand_dag(), links=network(latency=2, bandwidth=4))
        self.assertEqual(communication(w, "CPU0", "CPU0", 100), 0)
        self.assertEqual(communication(w, "CPU0", "CPU1", 8), 4)
        self.assertEqual(communication(w, "CPU0", "NPU0", 8), 4)
        with self.assertRaises(ModelError):
            communication(w, "CPU0", "UNKNOWN", 1)

def test_dependency_ready_and_running_observations(self):
        w = hand_dag()
        self.assertEqual(dependency_ready(observe(w, 0)), (("H-hand", "a"), ("L-hand", "l")))
        view = observe(w, 2, (Running("L-hand", "l", "CPU3", 0, 2),),
                       (Completed("H-hand", "a", "CPU0", 2),))
        self.assertEqual(dependency_ready(view), (("H-hand", "b"), ("H-hand", "c")))
        self.assertEqual(view.running[0].elapsed, 2)
        with self.assertRaises(ModelError):
            observe(w, 2, (Running("L-hand", "l", "CPU3", 0, 1),))

def test_future_and_duplicate_status_cannot_be_injected(self):
        for completed in [(Completed("H-hand", "a", "CPU0", 2),),
                          (Completed("unknown", "a", "CPU0", 0),),
                          (Completed("H-hand", "a", "GPU0", 0),)]:
            with self.subTest(completed=completed), self.assertRaises(ModelError):
                observe(hand_dag(), 1, completed=completed)
        with self.assertRaises(ModelError):
            observe(hand_dag(), 1, (Running("H-hand", "a", "CPU0", 0, 1),),
                    (Completed("H-hand", "a", "CPU0", 1),))

def test_noninterference_of_future_services_and_actual_durations(self):
        w = hand_dag()
        changed = tuple(replace(s, nodes=tuple(replace(n, durations=tuple(replace(d, realized=d.realized+1000)
                       for d in n.durations)) for n in s.nodes)) for s in w.services)
        future = Service("secret", 100, 1, "H", (node("hidden"),))
        other = Workload((*changed, future), network())
        self.assertEqual(observe(w, 0), observe(other, 0))
        self.assertNotIn("secret", repr(observe(other, 0)))

def test_all_explicit_illegal_trace_cases_rejected_with_expected_code(self):
        w = hand_dag()
        for name, expected, trace in negative_cases(simulate(w, "B1")):
            with self.subTest(case=name):
                result = validate_trace(w, trace)
                self.assertEqual(result["status"], "FAIL")
                self.assertIn(expected, {e["code"] for e in result["errors"]})

        trace["executions"][0].update(start=0, finish=1)

def test_same_time_wrong_event_phase_is_rejected(self):
        from p1_fixtures import simultaneous
        w = simultaneous()
        trace = simulate(w, "B1")
        indices = [i for i, e in enumerate(trace["events"]) if e["time"] == 2]
        i, j = indices[:2]
        trace["events"][i], trace["events"][j] = trace["events"][j], trace["events"][i]
        self.assertIn("EVENT_ORDER", {e["code"] for e in validate_trace(w, trace)["errors"]})

def test_validator_does_not_call_engine_runtime_metrics_or_transfer(self):
        w = hand_dag()
        trace = simulate(w, "B1")
        with patch("soc.simulator.engine.simulate", side_effect=AssertionError("engine called")), \
             patch("soc.metrics.fixture.summarize", side_effect=AssertionError("metrics called")), \
             patch("soc.model.schema.communication", side_effect=AssertionError("transfer called")), \
             patch("soc.scheduler.kernels.choose", side_effect=AssertionError("scheduler called")):
            self.assertEqual(validate_trace(w, trace)["status"], "PASS")
